Ripple Effect

General Properties

Classification

Attack Effects

Caused by

Walking under water with no protective equipment, fishing with Fishing Rod, some Creature Spells, using Spiritual Charm, pouring an Ewer with Holy Water onto the Ornamented Stone Pedestal.

Effect

Drown Damage over time.
